newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala president leaves for Chile summit.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala president leaves for Chile summit.

text.p: President Alvaro Arzu said Friday he would meet privately with the presidents of the Dominican Republic, Argentina and Chile and with the king of Spain while in Chile for the Iberoamerican Summit this weekend.
"This is a great opportunity for Guatemala as it rejoins the democracies of the world," Arzu told reporters at an airport news conference.
Military leaders have controlled Guatemala during most of the last 30 years.
The president said Guatemala would make a presentation about the nation's peace process during the summit.
Arzu, a businessman who became president in January, has firmly pushed peace negotiations between the government and leftist rebels.
